impl.summary:
The cross-arm group's crash is QEMU's own bug (cause i). qemu-user 8.2.2 builds a fake /proc/self/maps from its own record of the guest's mappings, and it crashes while reading that file if another thread maps or unmaps at the same moment. A panic's backtrace is symbolized by reading /proc/self/maps. With RUST_BACKTRACE=1, the crypt test that panics on purpose therefore read that file beside the crypt tests' mmap/munmap loop. A C program with four threads and no engine dies the same way 10 runs of 10 (repro/). The fix sets RUST_BACKTRACE=0 in the cross-arm case of scripts/check.sh. No test is compiled out, skipped or loosened.

Repair round 1 ran every extra mutant. Two of them found holes, and both are now closed:
(1) Putting RUST_BACKTRACE=0 after `--lib` turns it into a test-name filter. The group ran 0 tests and still exited 0, so that mutant survived. The case now captures the run's output, prints it, and requires a `test result: ok. N passed (N>=1) ... 0 filtered out` line. The same mutant is now red (exit 1).
(2) A lib unit test that formats `Backtrace::force_capture()` killed the group 1 run in 12 with the fix in place, a flaky red. A new source gate in tests/source.rs (`maps_readers`, with a tree test and a fixture test) refuses any line of src/, unit tests included, that has a /proc/self/maps literal, the word `Backtrace`, or a RUST_BACKTRACE / RUST_LIB_BACKTRACE literal. On the native target this mutant now fails deterministically.

The empty value, `=short`, and the line moved to the `test` case were each killed by the group with the QEMU SIGSEGV. So `0` is the only safe value. With the fix and the new check, cross-arm passed 3 of 3 runs by exit status with 530 tests run. The test, lint and lists (SUPDB_BASE=bc9cdd84) groups all exited 0. Notes, mutants.md and CLAUDE.md are updated. Nothing is committed.

impl.plain_store_cost: None. No compiled engine code changed; the diff is scripts/check.sh, tests/source.rs and CLAUDE.md. A plain store's paths, syscalls and instructions are unchanged.
impl.cipher_changes: None. Nothing under a cipher changed; no option, arm or default was touched.
plan_departures: Not option (a), (b) or (c) of the brief. The trigger is the run's environment: a symbolized backtrace reads the emulated /proc/self/maps. No test's own code triggers it, so the fix is the variable set in the group's case and no test is compiled out (round 0).

Round 1 adds two checks the brief did not ask for, each forced by a reviewer's mutant. The cross-arm case holds its run to `0 filtered out` and at least one test passed. A source gate in tests/source.rs refuses /proc/self/maps, Backtrace and RUST_BACKTRACE in src/.
The cross-arm case now captures its output and prints it at the end, as the fscrypt case does. A CI log of the job shows no progress during the roughly three minutes of the run.

Two lines of the new gate were removed before their mutants because nothing could reach them: the `.rs` filter (src/ holds no other file) and the lower-case `backtrace` word (a capture always names `Backtrace`).
not_verified: That GitHub's runner exports RUST_BACKTRACE (dtolnay/rust-toolchain is remembered to set =short). The case does not depend on it either way.
That no dependency of the lib reads /proc/self/maps at run time: the gate reads the lib's own source only.
A path to /proc/self/maps built at run time is not seen by the gate (one built with concat! is already refused by the door outside its modules).
QEMU's own stack: the static-pie binary is stripped (round 0).
Whether QEMU upstream has fixed the /proc/self/maps race: not looked up.

commit.gate: All gates green by exit status, run from a TMPDIR of their own (since removed). "sh scripts/check.sh build test lint": EXIT 0, 27 "test result: ok" lines, "all checks passed: build test lint". The two new source tests passed. "SUPDB_BASE=bc9cdd8472591d6343a74e467dc79827724d404e sh scripts/check.sh lists": EXIT 0. "sh scripts/check.sh cross-arm" three times in a row, with RUST_BACKTRACE=1 in the caller's environment: EXIT 0 each time, and each printed "test result: ok. 530 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out". The stride group was not run because no compiled engine code changed. Logs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-supdb/2fecfb3d-3630-50b2-b9c5-2a19705f39b6/scratchpad/plan/build/T22/commit/ (btl.log, lists.log, arm1.log, arm2.log, arm3.log). The commit message is msg.txt in the same directory.
problems: Nothing stray was removed: the working tree held only the change's three files (CLAUDE.md, scripts/check.sh, tests/source.rs). The ignored build outputs web/floor/target/ and web/supdb.wasm were left in place.

Not verified by me: whether GitHub's runner exports RUST_BACKTRACE (the case holds either way), whether QEMU upstream has fixed the /proc/self/maps race, and QEMU's own stack (its binary is stripped). These are left open in the commit body.
The source gate does not see a dependency that reads /proc/self/maps at run time, or a path to it put together at run time.
The unit's notes.md was not updated for the commit step. The gate's logs and the commit message are under the T22/commit/ directory.
